title: Data Checker Pipeline
intro: A supporting pipeline for IoT Gate to automate video frame extraction, filtering, and tagging.
summary: Python-based pipeline that reduced manual dataset prep by extracting and tagging frames from video streams. Integrated directly with IoT Gate outputs for training-ready datasets.
features: Structured outputs aligned with IoT Gate pipeline

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Automated pipeline built to extract, filter, and tag video frames for dataset creation, complementing IoT Gate.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Reduce manual dataset preparation effort for AI/vision training.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Developed Python scripts for frame extraction, filtering, tagging, and integrated flow with IoT Gate.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered consistent, structured training data with minimal manual labor.
